notes: A family card was crushing its own name to make room for two labels. Role badges wrapped when the name was long, leaving one pill taller than its neighbour and the card head out of alignment; badges never wrap or shrink now. That fixed the break but not the cause, so every state badge moved to its own row under the title, which takes the name from 132px to 353px and stops it truncating while leaving the weights list the room it needs. Also fixed: typing a fallback stack left the Generated CSS preview showing the previous one, while picking the same stack from the menu updated it.
